description: Imports a CAx / AutomationML (.aml) file on the serve host into the open project's hardware configuration. `option` decides what happens to a device that already exists: RetainTiaDevice (default — keep the project's device), OverwriteTiaDevice (replace it) or MoveToParkingLot. Archive the project first (tia_project_archive) before an overwrite: a failed import may have applied part of the file. Returns the transfer state, errors, warnings and messages (capped; messagesTruncated); a transfer whose state is Error or that counts any error is an error (500 cax_transfer_failed, those fields in details), and `unreadable` flags an outcome that could not be fully read. Serves up to app 1.6.3 return only an opaque `result` string even when the transfer failed — check the outcome with tia_devices. Maps to POST /cax/import {file, option}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.
